description: Read or change supported operating-system settings, animation scales, appearance, or app permissions on the selected target. Platform support varies by setting and action. Times out after 90s.

app.description: App the change targets, by bundle id, package name, or app name: the app `clear-app-state` clears, or the app a `permission` change (or an iOS-simulator `location on|off` privacy change) lands on. A name resolves to the installed app as `open` resolves it: an iOS simulator, local or Limrun, matches display names and accepts only an installed bundle id, and Android accepts only an installed package and refuses a name that resolves to an intent with `setting_app_not_package`. One that resolves to nothing is refused with `app_not_installed` before anything changes. The app need not be running. Without it the session app is used; a device-wide change (`location set` on any target, the Android `location on|off` toggle, `mobile-data`, macOS permissions) refuses one with `setting_app_not_consumed`. The CLI reads it only from this invocation, never from `AGENT_DEVICE_TARGET_APP` or config `targetApp`.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: settings
